The [[Sibilaari homeworld]] was '''destroyed''' by a cataclysm. The native [[Sibilaari]] were able to prepare for the destruction of their homeworld by building hardened bunkers in which members of the species hibernated. When the world was destroyed, chunks of the planet were flung into space, carrying the dormant survivors of the tragedy.
